_about: Senate special elections whose seat class the calendar can't decide: the state didn't hold the seat regularly up that year, so the special could have been for either of its seats. Each entry names the seat by the senator whose vacancy it filled. Every other contest's class follows from the calendar (midterms.seats.class_for_contest).
